scope: Independent CPU evaluation of actual shipped legacy donor high rig and exact runtime ReportEntrancePlayer, 60 Hz; no runtime/source modification; no physical Android evidence
units: model metres before lobby scale2.4 and yaw; floor is source model nominal y=0, not inferred visible platform collision

H01.quantizationHandling: Accessor.getElement() normalized decode; bind physical coordinates from actual bind jointWorld*IBM LBS (IBM contains dequantization). Strain is posed physical edge / bind physical edge, not raw Int16 coordinates.

palmOffsetDifference.note: Legacy socket is existing reviewed/approximate IK attachment, not independently segmented true palm surface. Disagreement proves anchor definitions differ, not which one is anatomically correct.

jointLimitDiagnostic.basis: Canonical anatomical world axes transported passively into actual legacy bind; this is a correspondence diagnostic, not independently reviewed legacy anatomical calibration.

threeSkinnedMeshCrosscheck.method: Construct THREE.SkinnedMesh with exact normalized BufferAttributes, exact Skeleton/IBM and mesh.bind(identity); compare getVertexPosition() to audit manual four-weight physical-space LBS. No image decoding or custom rendering involved.

rawDonorControls.scope: Raw embedded donor clips ONLY, no old runtime IK, source/static switch, source skin or VFX. These are not the old APK baseline and not proof old runtime was correct.
